summary.text: The smallest of Lang Ya blessed land's four continents, floating in the sky as the sacred land hairy men from the other three continents aspire to reach.

claims.text: It floats in the sky above Lang Ya blessed land as the fourth and smallest continent beside three sea continents of similar size. Five-colored light can shoot up from it and shine over the whole blessed land.
Cloud cities on it are mortal Gu Houses holding hairy man elites who are Gu Immortal seeds of Lang Ya Sect.

Within Lang Ya blessed land there are four continents. Three sit on the sea with similar sizes; the fourth is smallest but floats in the sky, known as Cloud Cover Continent, the sacred land hairy men from the other three continents aspire to reach. Lord Immortal declares from Cloud Cover Continent that seeds will be chosen every ten years to learn the ways of immortals, driving huge battles among the three continents.

On Cloud Cover Continent there are twelve cloud cities, each a mortal Gu House. When activated together they can form the twelve wave cloud confusion formation and cover the entirety of Cloud Cover Continent. The twelve cloud cities were created from the former twelve cloud buildings. The current Lang Ya land spirit likes grand appearances and differs from the previous one. Each hairy man Gu Immortal, including Lang Ya land spirit himself, occupies one cloud city, and Fang Yuan receives one city as the place he defends and lives. Lang Ya land spirit plans to trigger war among the three continents and move outstanding Gu Masters to Cloud Cover Continent for nurturing.
Cloud Cover Continent’s ground is made from cloud soil. It is white and slightly soft, unlike ordinary muddy ground.
In the sky at Cloud Cover Continent, Fang Yuan watches a will he sent seep into the mind of Steel Thread City’s city lord, then withdraws his gaze with a chuckle.
Fang Yuan flies down rapidly below Cloud Cover Continent and arrives at Black Hair Continent, one of the three continents.
Feng Jiu Ge sees Dang Hun Mountain at a certain area of Cloud Cover Continent, then strikes and stores many of its cloud cities, calling their hairy man elites Gu Immortal seeds of Lang Ya Sect.

Cloud Cover Continent was designed by Lang Ya land spirit personally. It is made of cloud soil and can float in the air without ever landing. The cloud soil is not tough. Fang Yuan’s myriad self giant hand, with rank seven attacking power, shatters surrounding cloud soil so fragments fall toward the vast sea below. When that hand lands, Lang Ya blessed land’s super immortal formation activates as silver light resembling flowing water on Cloud Cover Continent, and the strike leaves a huge handprint several meters deep.
